name: Sina
title: God's Covenant Mountain
lifespan: Not a person – a holy mountain associated with events around 1446 BC.
summary: Sina (Sinai) is not primarily a person in the Bible, but the name appears in the genealogies of the Old Testament. In 1 Chronicles 9:7, Sinaa (a variant of Sina) is mentioned among the descendants of Benjamin who returned from exile. He was the son of Hodaviah and belonged to the tribe of Benjamin.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of Benjamin
keyEvents.description: Sina (son of Hassenua/Hodaviah) is mentioned among the descendants of Benjamin who settled in Jerusalem after returning from the Babylonian exile.

keyEvents.title: The tribe of Benjamin returns
keyEvents.description: After the Babylonian exile, several families from the tribe of Benjamin returned to Jerusalem, and Sina was among those recorded in the genealogies.

keyEvents.title: Settlement in Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: Sina and his relatives were among those who settled in Jerusalem after their return home, contributing to rebuilding the community there.

keyEvents.title: The lineage of Benjamin
keyEvents.description: Benjamin's descendants played an important role in Israel's history, and the genealogies in Chronicles document their place among God's people.
